window: Monday 26 October – Sunday 1 November 2026 (Sunday-evening Dubai research cutoff)

sources.notes: Iranian negotiators in Doha; Qatari mediation; no final conclusion; reopening proposal conditional on a potential agreement. Script says Sunday talks in Doha (mediators were in Tehran Friday, Doha Saturday).
Voting 27 Oct; final results 30 Oct. Blocs 53 / 48 / 19; total 120; outright-majority threshold 61. Netanyahu remained prime minister. Formal submission 4 Nov.
Local truce began 27 Oct; arrivals 31 Oct; scheduled end 1 Nov evening. Route through Russia and Belarus; fighting continued elsewhere. No evacuee total used.
Demonstrations 31 Oct. Government estimate ~320,000; organizer estimates higher. Most marched peacefully; later clashes separate. Demands broadened to civil liberties.
Friday 30 Oct close. S&P 500 ≈ −1.8%; Nasdaq Composite ≈ −2.9%. Daily, not weekly. Do not label Nasdaq 100 as Nasdaq Composite.
Election Day Tuesday 3 Nov 2026. Control of Congress unresolved at the reporting cutoff.
